parameters.jsCode: const content_id=String($env.CAL50_MANUAL_RETRY_CONTENT_ID||'').trim();const approvedBy=String($env.CAL50_MANUAL_RETRY_APPROVED_BY||'').trim();if(!content_id||!approvedBy)throw new Error('NON_RETRYABLE: retry content ID and approver are required');return[{json:{content_id,approved_by:approvedBy}}];

const request=$('Retry Input').first().json;const matrix=$input.first().json.data||[];const [headers,...rows]=matrix;const col=name=>headers.indexOf(name);const raw=rows.find(row=>String(row[col('content_id')])===request.content_id);if(!raw)throw new Error('NON_RETRYABLE: content ID not found');const row=Object.fromEntries(headers.map((h,i)=>[h,raw[i]]));const retryable=new Set(['RENDER_TIMEOUT','RENDER_5XX','STORAGE_TIMEOUT','STORAGE_5XX','RETRY_EXHAUSTED']);if(row.status!=='failed'||!retryable.has(String(row.error_code)))throw new Error('NON_RETRYABLE: row is not a safe retry candidate');if(row.publish_id||row.published_at||row.error_code==='RECONCILE_REQUIRED')throw new Error('NON_RETRYABLE: reconcile publish outcome before retry');const now=new Date().toISOString();return[{json:{...row,status:'queued',claimed_at:'',claim_owner:'',retry_at:'',error_code:'',manual_retry_by:request.approved_by,manual_retry_at:now,updated_at:now}}];
